properties.areaDesc: Guam; Rota
properties.headline: Rip Current Statement issued October 19 at 3:55PM ChST until October 20 at 4:00AM ChST by NWS Tiyan GU
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking waves of 8 to 10
feet in the surf zone. For the High Rip Current Risk, dangerous rip
currents.

* WHERE...South and west facing reefs of Guam and Rota.

* WHEN...Until 4 AM ChST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions and
localized beach erosion. Rip currents can sweep even the best
swimmers away from shore into deeper water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The dominant, remnant southerly swell of Super
Typhoon Champi will slowly diminish, so surf along south and west
facing reefs will remain hazardous slightly longer through tonight.
Afterwards, surf may drop below the 9 feet threshold to allow for
an expiration early Tuesday morning.
properties.instruction:
Inexperienced swimmers should remain out of the water due to
dangerous surf conditions.

Rip currents will be life threatening. If caught in a rip
current, relax and float. Don't swim against the current. If
able, swim in a direction following the shoreline. If unable to
escape, face the shore and call or wave for help.

NWSheadline: HIGH SURF ADVISORY NOW IN EFFECT UNTIL 4 AM CHST TUESDAY... ...HIGH RIP CURRENT RISK NOW IN EFFECT THROUGH LATE TONIGHT

properties.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 18 at 9:51PM AKDT until October 19 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, south winds 20 to 30 kt
with gusts up to 45 kt expected. For the Gale Warning, south
winds 30 to 40 kt with gusts up to 55 kt and seas 6 to 8 ft
expected.

* WHERE...Northern Lynn Canal.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, from 10 AM to 10 PM AKDT
Monday. For the Gale Warning, from 10 PM Monday to 4 AM AKDT
Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
properties.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
